_rationale.react-doctor/no-giant-component: Subjective size heuristic. Splitting the wallet/payment screens it flags is an architectural refactor that is unsafe to perform blindly in a lint pass; deferred to a dedicated, reviewed effort.
_rationale.deslop/circular-dependency: The flagged cycles are the intentional zustand store cross-references and a type-only navigator<->screen import; they are runtime-safe and breaking them adds indirection without behavioral benefit.
_rationale.react-doctor/rn-no-dimensions-get: The flagged Dimensions.get() calls are at module scope (design-token getters and a module-level constant) where the useWindowDimensions hook is not valid.
_rationale.react-doctor/unsafe-json-in-html: The JSON.stringify call is browser-side runtime code inside the ZKP WebView (postMessage), not app data interpolated into HTML markup, so there is no XSS vector.
_rationale.react-doctor/rendering-svg-precision: The flagged path is a brand logo (WalletConnect); reducing coordinate precision would visibly distort the mark.
_rationale.react-doctor/rn-prefer-reanimated: The two flagged animations use the stable, supported React Native Animated API; migrating them to Reanimated is a preference, not a correctness fix.
_rationale.react-doctor/no-react19-deprecated-apis: forwardRef remains fully supported in React 19 (backward compatible); the flagged files include the ZKP-prover and fiat WebView shell (ref forwarding + useImperativeHandle) plus test mocks, where a rewrite carries more risk than the forward-looking nudge warrants.
_rationale.react-doctor/rn-prefer-expo-image: expo-image is not a dependency of this app; adding a native module requires a native rebuild, which is out of scope for a lint cleanup.
_rationale.react-doctor/js-hoist-intl: The single flagged `new Intl.NumberFormat` (src/utils/transak.ts getFiatFormatter) is already memoized per-currency in the module-level FIAT_FORMATTERS cache, so it is NOT reconstructed per call — the rule's premise does not hold, and hoisting to module scope is impossible because the formatter varies by currency.
